title: Remove custom CodeQL workflow conflicting with default Code Scanning setup
body:
The "Analyze Python" CodeQL job was failing because the repository has GitHub's built-in default Code Scanning setup enabled, which blocks SARIF uploads from custom (advanced) workflow configurations.

## Changes

- **Deleted `.github/workflows/codeql.yml`** — the custom CodeQL workflow is redundant and conflicts with the default setup. GitHub's default Code Scanning continues to handle Python analysis automatically on every push and PR.
